meta.title: TVTracker — Every show. Every film. Never lose track.
meta.description: Track every show and film you watch, see where to stream it, and know the moment your show comes back. Free on iPhone, Android and the web, in English and Arabic.

hero.lede: Tick off episodes, see where to stream, and know the moment your show comes back.

footer.attribution: Film and TV data and images from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Where-to-watch data by JustWatch. TVTracker is not affiliated with TV Time. © 2026 Alphabet.

switching.title: TV Time closed. Your history doesn't have to.
switching.text: Bring every show, episode and film you've logged — from TV Time, IMDb, Letterboxd, Trakt or any CSV. It takes about a minute.

phone.title: Importing your history
phone.from: From TV Time, IMDb, Letterboxd and Trakt

track.titleEm: We'll line up the next one.
track.lede: Your shows, in the order you're watching them. One tap marks the episode and the next one is ready — no hunting for where you left off.

left.title: Always know how far behind you are
left.text: +3 means three episodes waiting. FINALE and LATEST tell you when the end is near.

end.title: Finish a series, feel it
end.text: All caught up when you're level with a running show. Series complete — with confetti — when it's over for good.

sync.title: The same list everywhere
sync.text: Tick it on your phone, see it on the web. Your place travels with you.

feel.kick: Rate it, and say how it felt
feel.lede: After every episode, tell TVTracker how it left you — then see how everyone else took it. Twelve feelings, one for every kind of night.
feel.question: How did it make you feel?
feel.pickFirst: Pick a feeling to see how everyone else felt

up.lede: New episodes, season premieres and films, counted down to the day — with where to watch them. This is what's coming, live.
up.source: Dates and services from the TVTracker database (TMDB, JustWatch). US release dates.

stats.lede: Your watching, added up — the days you binged, the genres you live in, the feelings that stuck. Nothing to fill in: it builds itself as you tick.
stats.daysOf: That's {n} days of screen time. Worth it.

get.lede: Start in the browser — nothing to install — and pick up on your phone or tablet. Same shows, same place, in English or Arabic.

web.title: Web
web.text: Open it and go. Works in any browser, no install needed.

ios.title: iPhone & iPad
ios.text: Your list in your pocket, with reminders when your shows return.

android.title: Android
android.text: The same app, the same library, on any Android phone.

lang.title: English & العربية
lang.text: The whole app in both languages — right-to-left done properly.

perks.import: Import from TV Time, IMDb, Letterboxd & Trakt

get.finText: Lights down. Gold up. Your shows and films, all in one place — free.
